description: Record one social event such as an interaction, observation, milestone, or transaction. For interactions, milestones, and transactions the owner contact is auto-injected into participants if missing. Observations may omit the owner when recording third-party evidence.

input.description: Event payload. Always required. Interaction events also require `type`.

affectsBond.description: Whether evidence affects the relationship; defaults false for like/follow/repost labels and observations with significance <=2; explicit true opts in.

channel.description: Free-text channel, trimmed and lowercased, at most 40 characters.

content.description: Verbatim text, including empty text; at most 1 MB UTF-8. Summary may be omitted when content is supplied.

now.description: Optional timestamp override. Accepts epoch milliseconds integer, ISO 8601 date-time with Z/offset, YYYY-MM-DD, DD.MM.YYYY, today, tomorrow, yesterday, +3d or -2d. UTC midnight for dates; dueAt uses UTC end of day.

occurredAt.description: When the event occurred, Unix timestamp in milliseconds. Accepts epoch milliseconds integer, ISO 8601 date-time with Z/offset, YYYY-MM-DD, DD.MM.YYYY, today, tomorrow, yesterday, +3d or -2d. UTC midnight for dates; dueAt uses UTC end of day.

participants.description: Participant list. Must be non-empty and include the owner contact.

contactId.description: Participant contact id. The owner contact MUST be included.

type.description: Interaction subtype. Required when kind=interaction, omit otherwise.

name: record_event
